lines.text: In twenty twelve, a man bought an entire bank
Chicago was going to pay a million bucks
just to tear the decaying building down,
so an artist named Theaster offered them a single dollar instead.
The city handed him the keys,
but every banker refused to give him a renovation loan.
So Theaster walked into the ruined bathrooms,
ripped the marble slabs off the walls,
and carved them into luxury art pieces.
He sold each piece to collectors for five grand,
raising millions to rebuild the entire palace
Which is why nobody can believe that
